candidates.headline: Raiders place DE Keyron Crawford (ankle) on season-ending IR
candidates.description: Las Vegas Raiders rookie defensive end Keyron Crawford was placed on the season-ending injured reserve list because of an ankle injury.

candidates.headline: Texans place Tank Dell on IR as WR out at least 4 weeks
candidates.description: Tank Dell was placed on injured reserve Sunday as the team made its 53-man roster cuts, and the receiver won't be eligible to return to action until Week 5.
